claims: The 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four semifinals and championship game will air on TBS and truTV.
2026 Men's NCAA Final Four semifinal games will air on Saturday, April 4.
2026 Men's NCAA Final Four championship game will air on Monday, April 6.
Streaming of the 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four is available through March Madness Live.
Streaming of the 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four is available through Max (HBO Max).
Streaming of the 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four is available through Sling TV.
NCAA March Madness Live requires TV provider login.
Max is available with a subscription.
